text:
Sam: quick sync — trying a canary for a hybrid routing change on /v1/embeddings. idea: add a lightweight preflight header from client (`X-Embed-Hint: dims=1536;bytes=4096`) so router can pick small-batch fastpath vs large-shard path.
Katy: want to avoid clients having to compute dims in some flows. can server infer from payload?
Sam: yes, inference is possible but expensive at ingress. preflight is optional, fallback server-side parse if missing.
Jordan: curious about telemetry — we need signals to measure false-positive/negative routing. suggest emitting `embed.route_hint` + `route_taken` + `estimated_units` in trace.
Mike: agree. also track `split_events` when we chunk payloads. current dashboard has no metric for chunk vs pass-through.
Sam: adding `embed.route_hint` and `embed.split_count` to the span. can we keep granularity low? e.g., bucket split_count (0,1,2+).
Katy: UI question — how do we show this in Console without exploding cardinality? maybe put a toggle to surface split-rate with sample rate.
Jordan: sample-rate is key. proposal: 5% default telemetry for full traces, but counters for `split_total` / `requests_total` always. that gives ratio without heavy spans.
Mike: also need to capture dim mismatch cases where client hint != parsed dims. add `hint_mismatch` boolean. want to surface top tenants with mismatches.
Sam: ok. implementation sketch:
```http
POST /v1/embeddings
X-Embed-Hint: dims=1536;bytes=4096
content-type: application/json
```
server behaviour: if header present and valid -> route by hint; else parse body to estimate -> if parsing slow, route to default safe path. add `X-Embed-Route: fastpath|safe|split` on response for debugging.
Katy: could we add a short lived console flag per-tenant to opt-in to auto-hinting suggestions (console shows `suggested_hint` next to request sample)? that helps SDK users.
Jordan: concerns: SDKs that gzip or send batched arrays might have different bytes v dims relationship -> mismatch noise. need a normalization step in hint validation.
Mike: rollout plan: 1) internal canary on eng-internal org, 2) expose response header for debug, 3) open console opt-in, 4) 10% canary on public tenants, 5) full rollout. monitor split_rate, p50/p95 latency on fastpath vs safe, error rate.
Sam: metric names: `embeds.route.hint_provided{yes|no}`, `embeds.route.taken{fast|safe|split}`, `embeds.split.count_bucket{0|1|2_plus}`, `embeds.hint.mismatch_total`. add alerts if fastpath p95 worse than safe by > 20% for 15m.
ingress-bot: deploy queued: routing-canary v1.2 -> canary-cluster at 2023-09-24T15:12:00Z
Katy: quick UX note — console should avoid showing client header values verbatim (PII risk). only display normalized numeric dims/bytes.
Jordan: test plan — create synthetic payloads: single embed small, oversized dims, gzip-wrapped large, mixed dims array. assert route decision and split_count stable.
Mike: I'll draft a playbook for investigating anomalies (how to pull raw request for corseted tenants, how to correlate `split_count` with cost spikes).
Sam: thanks. @Jordan @Katy can you prototype the telemetry fields and a console mock next week? I'll wire routing logic and response header.
Jordan: on it.
Katy: can do.
Mike: noted, will write playbook.
